slides.title: of medical supplies delivered to northern Ethiopia by WHO
Three regions
slides.body: The World Health Organization delivered the supplies to Tigray, Amhara and Afar, Capital reported.

slides.title: What was sent
slides.body: Emergency health kits, cholera response materials, reproductive health kits, and medicines for chronic diseases.

slides.title: Who is paying
slides.body: Funding comes from the UN's emergency fund (CERF) and the European Union, WHO said. It also supports mobile health teams.

slides.title: Keep health care reaching every family.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
